title: Two-lane screen column drift
summary: Nine product screens of mixed sizes (wide, square, tall) rise through the frame in a staggered two-lane column at a constant speed, each lane a touch faster or slower, so a long screen tour reads as one calm, continuous scroll.
use_when: A product overview with many screens and no single hero view
Showing web and mobile layouts of one product side by side
A silent loop for a site hero, a booth screen or a showreel interlude
Background plate behind a statement or logo in a longer film

look.type_style: rounded geometric sans, medium weight, size label centred on each screen at ~4 % H (6 % on wide screens), a tiny 3-line note at ~1 % H under the label of the first wide screen

sfx.event: a new screen crosses the bottom edge

structure.shot: empty pale field; first wide pale screen rises from the bottom edge, size label then a 3-line note appear as it climbs
structure.camera: dolly up, easings.linear, ~0.26 H/s (12.5 px/fr at 1920 wide), no zoom
structure.motion: screen enters at 0.27 s from below frame, easings.linear rise, no own animation (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: saturated square screen (left lane) and white tall screen (right lane) rise under the wide one, square overlaps it
structure.motion: square enters 2.50 s, tall screen 2.77 s: stagger 8 fr (±0.25 s); lane speeds differ ~0.23 to 0.29 H/s

structure.shot: small pale square enters lower left while the wide screen leaves past the top edge
saturated wide screen rises across both lanes, small square overlaps its top edge; it owns the centre around 8.0 to 9.0 s
structure.motion: enters 5.77 s, easings.linear; layered under the small square (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: second small pale square appears under the wide screen, right of centre
structure.motion: enters 8.77 s, tucked under the wide screen, easings.linear (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: white tall screen enters lower left; lanes have swapped sides compared with the first half
saturated tall screen enters lower right while the wide screen exits at the top
last wide pale screen rises behind the saturated tall screen and climbs to the centre as the others leave
structure.motion: enters 12.00 s under the tall screen (lower z), easings.linear; tall screen exits top ~16.0 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: last wide screen drifts out past the top edge; the empty pale field from frame 0 returns
structure.motion: exit by the same linear rise, gone by ~17.8 s; nothing new enters (±0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, accent for the saturated screens, a pale accent tint and surface white for the others
params.content.screens: ordered list of screenshots with kind wide | square | small | tall; default order wide, square, tall, small, wide, small, tall, tall, wide
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; lanes recompose, screen widths scale to the frame width
params.timing.speed: rise speed in frame heights per second (default 0.26)
params.timing.gap: seconds between screen entries (default ~1.0, pairs 8 fr apart)
params.labels: show size labels on placeholder screens (default false in a real film)

notes: Single shot, no cuts, silent; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Measured from 4 fps sheets: constant upward travel ~0.26 frame heights per second (motion.json -322 to -413 px/s at 1920 wide), per-screen speeds 0.23 to 0.29 H/s give a light parallax; no zoom, no rotation (motion.json zoom/rot noise comes from the parallax). A new screen crosses the bottom edge about every 1 s. First and last frames are the empty field, so it loops. Proposed term: parallax-cascade (not in the vocabulary).
